decision.reason: Retain the fastest tested 32-row kernel. The full-duty live attempt hit the lab 95 C sensor guard; qualify sustained live operation separately at 80% intensity. Do not present the full-duty offline rate as a continuously safe live rate.

failed_experiment_notes.cause: Lab coordinator queue.py shadowed the Python standard-library queue module. Renamed the coordinator; preserved the failed attempt and reran as kernel-retry-v2. No candidate speed was obtained from this failure.

Full-duty live trial stopped at the independent lab 95 C average-sensor guard after about 119 seconds. Two accepted and zero rejected shares; arithmetic verification did not fail. Preserve the stop and retest both miners at 80% intensity.
